material.acceptance_criteria: The server crate builds for wasm32-wasip1 in CI and runs the default image headless for a fixed tick count under a wasip1 runtime, with state_hash equal to the native build's value for the same inputs.
material.description: Remote main (b62d476) has no wasm32-wasip1 target anywhere: .github/workflows/ci.yml:204-220 builds only wasm32-wasip2 for rust/crates/wasip2 (sim only). The server crate rust/crates/server (Cargo.toml, bin oscraftd) depends on std::net TcpStream (rust/crates/server/src/http.rs:2) and is native-only, so the wasip1 server the goal names does not exist.
material.resolution: Deviation from the row text: wasip1 target is a guest (rust/crates/wasip1) with a native host, not a socket server, because wasip1 has no socket API. The guest runs the sim over stdin/stdout (tick, state, order) and the wasm32-wasip1 build produces the guest. The CI job checks the guest through the host and prints wasip1 tick ok ticks=10 units=n. Native-only deps are cfg-gated so wasm32-wasip1 does not compile wasmtime.
material.subject: Server has no wasm32-wasip1 build; only the sim is a wasip2 component
material.witness: ci-status run 38898433813 for 8298e8814d9793e3efa4dc04488b0150a2f2e0c9; job sim as wasip1 guest driven over stdio
material.witness_plan: CI job builds the server for wasm32-wasip1, runs it under wasmtime for N ticks on the default image, and compares the printed state_hash with the native run.
